source_text: Dyspareunia, or painful intercourse, is reported in up to 30-50% of affected women in global Type 1 cases, attributed to scar contracture and reduced lubrication, with analogous findings in Bohra surveys where participants described ongoing discomfort during sexual activity. [34]
